name: ch4_fig17_fva_intervals
prompt: Title (top): "FVA 반응별 허용 구간" + smaller warm-grey "Flux Variability Analysis". Draw one shared thin horizontal flux axis with its center tick labeled "0" once in red. Add exactly four aligned rows labeled "차단", "목표 유지에 필요", "고정 활성", and "유연". The "차단" row is exactly one blue point centered on 0 with no interval line and no X. The "목표 유지에 필요" row is one blue horizontal interval entirely to the positive side of 0 with two orange endpoint dots. The "고정 활성" row is exactly one blue point on the positive side with no interval line or arrow. The "유연" row is one blue horizontal interval whose endpoints lie on opposite sides of 0. Intervals are plain line segments, never arrows or parallel bands. FINAL RASTER OVERRIDE: make every large shape interior exactly the same uniform off-white as the background and communicate semantic color with a single-color outline only. Allow solid color only in tiny markers. Render as a stark SVG wire diagram with fills disabled, never as polished presentation art or glassmorphism. Within any object, every interior pixel must have identical RGB; a lighter center, darker edge, glow, or soft transition is total failure. HARD QA: every point and endpoint has one perfectly uniform solid fill and every line has one uniform color. No gradient, highlight, lighting, transparency, glow, bevel, shadow, or tonal variation anywhere. Keep all artwork at least 120 px from every canvas edge. Visible text is restricted to the exact double-quoted strings in this prompt; no other numbers, arrows, symbols, captions, or labels.
